resources.string: This service allows AMI to inspect the UI of other apps to provide assistance.
When you ask for help, AMI reads the text and button labels visible in whatever app is open, and sends them to a third-party AI service so it can work out what to tap next.
AMI speaks each step and points to one button at a time, so you never have to guess what to press.
If you set up reminders, AMI asks you by voice at the scheduled time and remembers your answer.

If you miss a check-in, AMI emails the first caregiver you have chosen. If nobody answers the phone at all, or the misses keep adding up, it works down the rest of your list. Nobody outside that list is ever contacted.
It never reads passwords or banking
Password fields are skipped on your device, and AMI refuses to read banking, payment and authenticator apps at all. Nothing from them is sent anywhere.
You can add or change who gets alerted at any time in Settings.

How AMI uses your health data

AMI reads your step count, weight, height, blood pressure and blood sugar from Health Connect so it can suggest suitable food and notice a reading that needs attention.
This data stays on your phone. It is never sold, never shared with advertisers, and never sent to anyone except the caregivers you configure — and then only when a reading needs urgent attention, when you miss your medicine check-ins, or in the weekly summary if you have left it switched on.
Anything you type in yourself is also saved back to Health Connect so your other health apps can see it. You can withdraw these permissions at any time in Health Connect settings.

AMI is a digital caretaker. It reads the screen when you ask for help, speaks each step out loud, reminds you about medicine, and can tell your caregivers if a check-in is missed.
It is not a medical device and does not diagnose anything.

AMI reads the screen only while guiding a request you made, and only the text and button labels needed to work out the next step. Password fields are skipped. Banking, payment and authenticator apps are refused outright.
Screen contents are never stored. What is stored on this phone: your medicines, your check-in answers, your wellbeing readings, your caregivers and your settings.
The only thing that leaves this phone is a caregiver summary, sent to the addresses you chose, and the screen text sent to the AI service while a request is being guided.

AMI is provided as-is, with no warranty. It is not a substitute for medical care or emergency services, and it cannot detect a fall or monitor you continuously.
You are responsible for checking that medicine reminders match what you have actually been prescribed.
